protocol: SubspaceAD official main.py, fp16 (--smoke_half), native evaluator
note: All categories of a dataset run in one process per (seed, K) so the upstream K-shot shuffle sees a fixed category order; the earlier 12-unit small matrix (2 categories per process) is not merged. fp16 via --smoke_half is an accuracy adaptation. The native evaluator computes P-AUROC/P-AP on its own stride-8 subsample of the 672x672 map and AU-PRO at full resolution.
